title: 長江三峽大壩工程~Three Gorges Dam Engineering
focus: 長庫區洪水預報與航運發電耦合~Flood forecasting and navigation generation coupling in a long reservoir
summary: 以三峽大型複合工程為背景，進一步追蹤預報偏差如何耗用防洪空間、長庫區流量如何轉成不均勻水位，以及泥砂和溫度如何改變調度判斷。學員把船閘用水、機組淨水頭及電力爬坡列成可核對帳本，避免只用總裝機容量代表每個時段的可供電力。~Using Three Gorges as context, trace how forecast bias consumes flood space, how flow produces spatially varying levels, and how sediment and temperature affect decisions. Build auditable accounts of lock water, turbine net head and electrical ramping, recognizing that installed capacity cannot describe deliverable power in every interval.
history: 業主介紹將三峽列為混凝土重力壩與航運、發電、防洪結合的工程，記錄一九九四年開始施工，二〇一二年主要機組全部投產。這些是工程背景而非本課假想洪水的校準資料。本新增單元延續原有課程，將焦點放在跨系統守恆及不確定性；一九八七年的監測手冊只是方法文獻年代，二〇二六年則標示教材覆核。蓄水高程與壩體高度分別定義，不能因數字近似便互換使用。~The owner describes a concrete gravity dam combining navigation, generation and flood management, with construction beginning in 1994 and the main generating units all operating in 2012. These milestones establish context rather than calibrate the hypothetical flood in this course. The added units extend earlier lessons through conservation across subsystems and uncertainty. The 1987 instrumentation reference dates literature, while 2026 dates curriculum review. Reservoir elevation and structural dam height retain different reference datums and cannot be interchanged.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「洪峰預報偏差帳」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「分段庫容積分」及「泥砂質量與淤積」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3；第二組為 A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Flood forecast bias account, then compare the controlling variables in Piecewise storage integration and Sediment mass and deposition. The first calculation is dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3; the second is A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 洪峰預報偏差帳~Flood forecast bias account
units.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳~Flood forecast bias account
units.mechanism: 大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。入流偏差會隨時間積分成庫容偏差，即使瞬時流量差看似不大，也可能持續耗用預留空間。模型必須以相同時間窗對齊雨量預報、支流到達與下游限制，不能把更新前後的預報當成兩股來水。 逐時正負誤差可能在期末抵消，但最大累積偏差仍決定需要保留的暫時空間，應同時報告兩種量。~Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release. Inflow bias integrates over time into storage error, so a modest flow discrepancy can consume reserved space when it persists. Rainfall predictions, tributary arrival and downstream restrictions must share a time window; forecast revisions are alternative estimates, not additional streams of water. Positive and negative hourly errors may cancel at the endpoint, while the maximum cumulative error still determines temporary space requirements; report both quantities.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。模型邊界：偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3. Model boundary: constant bias throughout the interval, omitting surface rainfall, evaporation and withdrawals; this is forecast error volume only.
units.verify: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。另查出流儀表是否延遲，若流量偏差與水位變化不閉合，先排除時間戳及曲線版本不同，不直接調整防洪限制。~Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Check release-meter delay separately. If flow imbalance and level change disagree, investigate timestamps and curve versions before interpreting the discrepancy as lost flood space.
units.failure: 預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。~Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. An unusual level can also reflect backwater or datum drift, so a second water-balance observation is needed before assigning the discrepancy to forecast failure.
units.misconception: 每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水~Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow.
units.practice: 建立六小時誤差帳，再把偏差改成前半正值、後半負值，分別比較最大暫存量與期末淨增量，說明兩者對預留空間的意義不同。~Build a six-hour error account, then reverse the bias sign halfway through. Compare maximum temporary storage with the final net increment and explain why they imply different space requirements.

units.anchor: 分段庫容積分~Piecewise storage integration
units.title: 分段庫容積分~Piecewise storage integration
units.mechanism: 水位與庫容通常不是固定面積的線性關係，山谷展寬會讓同一水位增量對應不同體積。用相鄰高程的水面面積做梯形積分，是資料稀疏時可檢查的近似；但支流庫灣及回水的空間差異仍須另外處理，不能把單站水位當成全庫水平面的證明。 若測深採用的水位基準與岸線高程不同，整張容量曲線會偏移，因此測量基準屬於模型輸入的一部分。~Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area. A widening valley gives different volumes for equal level increments. Trapezoidal integration between surveyed areas provides a transparent approximation when data are sparse, but tributary bays and backwater remain spatial effects that a single gauge cannot resolve. A mismatch between bathymetric water-level datum and shoreline elevations shifts the capacity curve; reference control is therefore part of the model input.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。模型邊界：相鄰斷面的面積隨高程線性變化且假設靜水面；不是完整庫容曲線。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3. Model boundary: area changes linearly with elevation between observations and the surface is level; this is not a complete capacity curve.
units.verify: 以相同垂直基準疊合兩次測量輪廓，檢查支流庫灣是否被遺漏，再把高程間距減半比較積分變化。若細分結果差異集中在一段高程，應補查地形轉折，而非以整庫平均面積掩蓋局部誤差。~Overlay survey contours in one vertical datum and check missing tributary bays. Halve the elevation interval and compare integrated volumes. If the change concentrates in one elevation band, investigate a terrain transition rather than hiding local error behind a reservoir-wide mean area.
units.failure: 岸線插值錯誤會讓可用庫容被高估，尤其在淹沒平台突然展寬的位置；這類幾何誤差與蒸發損失的時間特徵不同，可用靜水測量及多次水量閉合分辨。~Incorrect shoreline interpolation can overstate usable storage, especially where a submerged terrace widens abruptly. This geometric error behaves differently from evaporation loss and can be distinguished using static surveys and repeated balance closure.
units.misconception: 相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容~Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage.
units.practice: 畫出三個高程的面積曲線，加入中間面積與端點線性值不同的情境，計算粗細兩種積分差並提出最值得補測的高程區間。~Plot areas at three elevations and make the middle area differ from linear interpolation. Calculate coarse and refined volumes, then identify the elevation band where another survey would be most valuable.

units.anchor: 泥砂質量與淤積~Sediment mass and deposition
units.title: 泥砂質量與淤積~Sediment mass and deposition
units.mechanism: 懸浮泥砂先以乾質量守恆，沉積後再透過乾容重轉成體積，兩個步驟不可混用水的密度。流量、濃度與攔砂比例共同控制入庫及留庫質量；細粒壓密會隨時間改變體積，因此一次估算的體積不能直接當成永久損失曲線。 乾容重包含沉積孔隙的體積效應，壓密後即使乾質量不變，對應占據庫容仍可能減少，需明示測量齡期。~Suspended sediment is first conserved as dry mass and then converted to deposited volume using dry bulk density, not water density. Discharge, concentration and trapping fraction jointly control incoming and retained mass. Fine material consolidates over time, so one volume estimate does not establish a permanent capacity-loss curve. Dry bulk density includes pore-volume effects, so consolidation can reduce occupied storage without changing dry mass; specify the age of the surveyed deposit.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3。模型邊界：流量濃度及截留比例皆固定；不含床載、再懸浮及後續壓密。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3. Model boundary: constant flow, concentration and trapping fraction; excludes bed load, resuspension and subsequent consolidation.
units.verify: 同時採集不同水深的濃度樣本，核對濁度換算是否跨越粒徑改變，再用沉積岩心乾重與體積估算容重。將質量帳與測深體積比較時必須採相同期間，否則洪水後壓密會被誤認為泥砂離庫。~Sample concentration at several depths, check whether turbidity calibration spans changing grain sizes, and obtain dry bulk density from cores. Compare mass and bathymetric volume over the same period; otherwise consolidation after a flood may be mistaken for sediment leaving the reservoir.
units.failure: 只用表層濃度容易漏掉近底高濃度流，低估留庫質量；若直接用顆粒實體密度換算，還會忽略孔隙而低估沉積體積，兩項誤差可能同向疊加。~Surface samples can miss concentrated near-bed flow and understate retained mass. Converting with particle density also ignores pore space and understates deposited volume, allowing both errors to reinforce one another.
units.misconception: 沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算~Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density.
units.practice: 以兩種乾容重重算同一留庫質量，再令洪水濃度隨流量先升後降，繪出質量輸入曲線，說明單一平均濃度會遺失哪些時序資訊。~Recalculate one retained mass using two dry bulk densities, then make concentration rise and fall around the flood peak. Plot incoming mass and identify timing information lost by one average concentration.

units.anchor: 分層取水混溫~Layered withdrawal temperature mixing
units.title: 分層取水混溫~Layered withdrawal temperature mixing
units.mechanism: 深庫水溫分層會讓相同總流量具有不同下游熱負荷。理想混合先以各支流質量流率乘比熱與溫度作能量守恆，再求共同出口溫度；開口所在高程不等於實際吸入水層，因取水流束可能跨越密度界面，必須量測垂向剖面。 熱量帳應明示共同參考溫度；在相同比熱近似下參考值會相消，但水流的實際來源與交換路徑不能省略。~Thermal stratification allows equal total releases to carry different downstream heat loads. Ideal mixing conserves each stream mass flow multiplied by heat capacity and temperature. The elevation of an opening does not uniquely identify the withdrawn layer, because the intake flow can entrain water across a density interface. The heat account needs a common reference temperature; it cancels under equal heat capacities, while stream origins and exchange paths still require explicit identification.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC。模型邊界：兩水流密度比熱相同、完全混合且無外界熱交換；不代表生態合格溫度。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC. Model boundary: equal density and heat capacity, complete mixing and no external heat exchange; not an ecological compliance temperature.
units.verify: 在取水口上游布設垂向溫度剖面，並量測混合後斷面的橫向差異。以總流量與熱量殘差檢查混合是否完成；若出口單點溫度符合算值而橫向差異仍大，不能宣稱整個河段具有同一熱環境。~Measure an upstream vertical temperature profile and lateral differences after mixing. Check total flow and heat residuals. If one outlet sensor matches the calculation while lateral differences remain large, the entire receiving reach cannot be described by that single temperature.
units.failure: 水躍或分層流可能使冷水沿底部延伸，表面測值會掩蓋底層熱衝擊；感測器反應慢也可能削弱短時變化，應將空間不均與儀器滯後分別辨識。~Stratified release can carry cold water along the bed while surface readings hide the thermal change. Slow sensor response can also suppress short events, so spatial nonuniformity and instrument lag require separate diagnosis.
units.misconception: 出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度~The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.
units.practice: 固定總出流，求得另一目標溫度所需冷暖流量比例，再列出若冷水層厚度不足時模型失效的證據，以及需補充的剖面量測。~Hold total release constant and solve the warm-to-cold flow ratio for another target temperature. List observations showing that insufficient cold-layer thickness invalidates the assumption and specify additional profile measurements.

units.anchor: 船閘用水時序~Lockage water timing
units.title: 船閘用水時序~Lockage water timing
units.mechanism: 船閘升降依靠閘室水位變化，船隻排水量在同船進出且水位轉換完整時不應重複計入。教材先用閘室平面積乘水位差建立一個升降階段的幾何水量，再把循環次數放到時段帳中；多級閘室之間的共享水及回收系統必須另建連接關係。 每個閘室都應有控制體，級間移轉在整體帳內會互相抵消，只有跨越外部邊界的水量才形成淨耗用。~A lock changes chamber level to move vessels. Vessel displacement must not be counted repeatedly when the same vessel enters and leaves a complete level-change cycle. Chamber area times lift gives one stage geometric volume; the number and timing of cycles then enter the water account. Shared water between stages requires an explicit connection model. Each chamber needs a control volume; interstage transfers cancel in the overall account, and only flow crossing its external boundary contributes to net use.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A=4200 m2; dh=18 m; N=12 cycles/day; V=A*dh*N=907200 m3/day。模型邊界：單獨閘室每次完全換水且無回收；不能乘上所有級數當作實際多級閘耗水。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A=4200 m2; dh=18 m; N=12 cycles/day; V=A*dh*N=907200 m3/day. Model boundary: one isolated chamber exchanges a full volume each cycle without recovery; do not multiply by every stage to infer actual multistage consumption.
units.verify: 用閘室水位曲線識別充水與排水開始時間，核對閥門流量積分與幾何體積，再追蹤水究竟來自上游庫區或鄰室。若只記錄通船艘數而未記實際升降循環，共閘通行會使估計耗水失真。~Identify filling and emptying from chamber level traces, compare integrated valve flow with geometric volume, and track whether water comes from the reservoir or a neighboring chamber. Vessel count alone misstates water use when several vessels share one actual lockage cycle.
units.failure: 閥門漏水會使停等期間仍有水量移轉，幾何升降帳因而不能閉合；但多艘共閘與級間調水也會造成表面差異，應先辨認流程再指認設備洩漏。~Valve leakage transfers water during waiting periods and prevents geometric closure. Shared lockages and interstage transfers can produce similar apparent differences, so the operating sequence must be reconstructed before diagnosing equipment leakage.
units.misconception: 通船艘數就是獨立升降循環數~Vessel count is the same as the number of independent lockage cycles.
units.practice: 設計一張十二次升降的時程表，加入兩次共閘與一次漏水事件，分別用艘數法和循環積分法估算水量，指出應由哪個感測器辨識差異。~Create a schedule of twelve cycles with two shared lockages and one leakage event. Compare vessel counting with cycle integration and identify which measurement distinguishes the resulting water-account differences.

units.anchor: 升船機平衡偏差~Ship lift balance imbalance
units.title: 升船機平衡偏差~Ship lift balance imbalance
units.mechanism: 水槽式升船裝置的理想平衡取決於槽內總重量，而非只看船重。浮船進槽時通常排出相應水量，若槽內水位維持不變，載船前後總重近似不變。教材把殘餘不平衡質量與摩擦分開，藉此辨認驅動功率、制動及結構載重是不同問題。 船仍漂浮時排水質量與船重相等，若船體接觸槽底則浮力條件改變，不能再使用原先重量替代關係。~A water-filled ship lift is balanced by total trough weight, not vessel weight alone. A floating vessel displaces approximately its own weight of water when the trough level is maintained. Separate residual imbalance from friction to distinguish driving power, braking requirements and structural load, which are different engineering questions. Displaced water mass equals vessel mass while the vessel floats; grounding changes that buoyancy condition and invalidates the original weight-substitution relationship for the trough.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dm=18000 kg; g=9.81 m/s2; v=0.08 m/s; eta=0.80 (dimensionless); P=dm*g*v/eta=17658 W。模型邊界：僅算固定速度下不平衡重力功率，不含摩擦加速及制動冗餘。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dm=18000 kg; g=9.81 m/s2; v=0.08 m/s; eta=0.80 (dimensionless); P=dm*g*v/eta=17658 W. Model boundary: gravitational imbalance power at constant speed only; excludes friction, acceleration and braking redundancy.
units.verify: 以槽水位、排出水量和稱重記錄核對浮力替代關係，再比較空槽與載船的同速電流。若差值隨運動方向改變，應檢查摩擦與導向偏載；若與水位偏差一致，才支持殘餘重量解釋。~Compare trough level, displaced water and weighing records, then compare empty and occupied trough current at equal speed. Direction-dependent differences suggest friction or guide loading, whereas a consistent relation with level error supports an imbalance-weight explanation for the extra demand.
units.failure: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。~Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. A binding guide also raises current without the same static weight change, allowing weighing and direction tests to distinguish the two mechanisms.
units.misconception: 大船入槽一定等量增加升降總重~A heavier floating vessel always adds its full weight to the lifted total.
units.practice: 把水位誤差換算成新增水重，與給定不平衡質量比較，再列出加速度與導向摩擦所需額外資料，繪製完整功率帳而不把缺項設成零。~Convert a level error into added water mass and compare it with the stated imbalance. List additional data needed for acceleration and guide friction, and build a complete power account without silently setting missing terms to zero.

units.anchor: 淨水頭功率帳~Net head power account
units.title: 淨水頭功率帳~Net head power account
units.mechanism: 發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。尾水抬升與攔污柵阻塞都會降低淨水頭，卻有不同的量測位置及維修責任。把水力功率、軸功率與電功率依效率串接，才能避免在不同儀表邊界間重複扣損。 速度水頭必須和壓力水頭使用相容斷面，若兩端斷面差異很大，僅以靜水位差代替能量差會有偏差。~Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation. Tailwater rise and trash-rack blockage both reduce net head but have different measurement locations and maintenance implications. Distinguish hydraulic, shaft and electrical power when applying efficiencies so that losses are not deducted twice across instrument boundaries. Velocity and pressure heads require compatible sections; markedly different inlet and outlet sections make a simple static-level difference an incomplete estimate of energy difference.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，效率為水力輸入至電端總效率；未計暫態及可用率。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW. Model boundary: steady incompressible flow with overall hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency; transients and availability are excluded.
units.verify: 同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。若損失隨流量平方增加而機組效率曲線正常，先查引水阻力，不把全部差值歸因於轉輪劣化。~Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections. If loss grows approximately with flow squared while the turbine efficiency trend remains normal, investigate conveyance resistance before assigning the entire discrepancy to runner deterioration.
units.failure: 尾水資料延遲會造成虛假的效率升降，尤其在快速增載後；堵塞柵前後的壓差才是局部損失證據，不能僅由電力降低推定必須更換機組。~Delayed tailwater data create artificial efficiency changes after load increases. Differential pressure across a blocked rack is evidence of local loss; reduced electrical output alone does not establish that the generating unit needs replacement.
units.misconception: 壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭~Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head.
units.practice: 分別增加尾水高程及柵損失，保持其他輸入不變重算功率，再畫出兩個情境所需量測位置，說明相同功率下降為何需要不同處理。~Increase tailwater level and rack loss in separate scenarios while holding other inputs constant. Recalculate power and locate the measurements needed to explain why equal power reductions require different responses.

units.anchor: 電力爬坡能量~Electrical ramp energy
units.title: 電力爬坡能量~Electrical ramp energy
units.mechanism: 電網要求的功率爬坡會沿水力傳動鏈改變流量及壓力，但功率斜率與累計能量是不同維度。先以功率時間曲線求能量，再檢查水量及暫態約束是否容許該曲線；額外能量只是相對基線的面積，不能將爬坡末值乘全時段而忽略初值。 功率曲線下面積的單位是能量，曲線斜率則是功率每時間，將兩者分開才能對照不同調度合約要求。~A grid power ramp changes flow and pressure through the hydraulic chain, but ramp rate and accumulated energy have different dimensions. Integrate the power-time curve first, then check water and transient constraints. Additional energy is the area above a baseline, not the final power multiplied by the whole ramp duration. Area under a power curve is energy, whereas its slope is power per time; separating them permits comparison with different dispatch requirements and limits.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh。模型邊界：假設電端功率線性爬坡，不表示水力暫態或電網限制已獲滿足。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh. Model boundary: linear electrical power ramp only; hydraulic transient and grid constraints are not thereby satisfied.
units.verify: 以秒級電功率積分核對時段電表，再將調度命令、導葉位置與壓力峰值按時間對齊。若總電量正確但壓力有尖峰，問題屬爬坡形狀而非能量帳；應保留原始波形，不只保存十五分鐘平均值。~Integrate second-scale terminal power and compare the interval meter, then align dispatch commands, guide-vane position and pressure peaks. Correct total energy with a pressure spike indicates a ramp-shape problem, so retain raw waveforms instead of only fifteen-minute averages for the diagnosis.
units.failure: 只核對時段電量會漏掉短時壓力超越或機組振動，因正負功率偏差可能互相抵消；若時間戳錯位，也會把先前的壓力事件錯配到後續命令。~Checking interval energy alone can miss brief pressure or vibration excursions because positive and negative power errors cancel. Timestamp misalignment can additionally attach an earlier pressure event to a later dispatch command.
units.misconception: 總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同~Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.
units.practice: 比較線性爬坡與先快後慢的兩段曲線，使兩者總電量相同，再指出哪幾個水力與電氣量必須高頻記錄才能判斷各自限制。~Compare a linear ramp with a two-stage fast-then-slow ramp having equal energy. Identify the hydraulic and electrical variables requiring rapid recording to determine the different constraints on each trajectory.

units.anchor: 長庫區回水高差~Long reservoir backwater difference
units.title: 長庫區回水高差~Long reservoir backwater difference
units.mechanism: 有持續流量通過的長庫區並非處處靜水面，水面坡度同時受斷面、摩阻與下游控制影響。教材先以已量測平均坡度換算兩站高差，建立空間尺度感；真正回水分析仍需能量方程及各斷面資料，不能用一條坡線外推所有支流。 水面坡度與能量坡度並不總相等，流速水頭沿程改變時需要補入能量方程，尤其在斷面突變附近。~A long reservoir carrying flow does not have a level surface everywhere. Section geometry, friction and downstream control jointly influence the water-surface slope. A measured mean slope can estimate the difference between two stations, but actual backwater analysis requires energy equations and cross sections rather than one line extrapolated through every tributary. Water-surface slope and energy slope are not always equal; changing velocity head requires an energy correction, particularly near abrupt changes in cross-sectional geometry.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m。模型邊界：坡度為無因次且只代表該時段兩站平均水面坡度；不是摩阻坡度定律。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m. Model boundary: dimensionless slope represents the observed mean water-surface gradient between two stations in one interval, not a friction-slope law.
units.verify: 先統一兩站水準基準並校正訊號時間，再比較低流量與洪水時的高差。若高差會隨流量改變而基準點穩定，支持水力回水解釋；若所有流量下都出現固定偏移，應先檢查測站基準。~Unify gauge datums and synchronize signals before comparing low-flow and flood differences. A flow-dependent difference with stable benchmarks supports a hydraulic explanation. A fixed offset across all flow conditions instead calls for checking the reference elevations and calibration of the gauges.
units.failure: 把上游洪水抬升全歸因於壩前水位，會漏掉沿程壅水及支流匯入作用；反之，基準錯差也可能偽裝成坡度，必須用獨立水準測量拆解。~Attributing all upstream flood rise to the dam-front level overlooks reach backwater and tributary inputs. Conversely, a datum error can imitate a water-surface gradient and requires independent leveling to separate it from hydraulics.
units.misconception: 水庫水面在任何流量下皆為水平~A reservoir surface is level at every discharge.
units.practice: 在同一長度下試算兩倍坡度的高差，並畫出支流匯入口前後應設的測站，說明哪些資料可檢查平均坡度假設，哪些需一維或二維模型。~Double the slope over the same length, then locate gauges around a tributary junction. Explain which observations test the mean-slope assumption and which questions require a one- or two-dimensional hydraulic model.

units.anchor: 多感測殘差判讀~Multiple sensor residual diagnosis
units.title: 多感測殘差判讀~Multiple sensor residual diagnosis
units.mechanism: 監測值可先扣除已校準的水位與季節效應，留下用來追查異常的殘差。標準化殘差有助比較不同單位的量測，但前提是基線期間與變異估計有效；相鄰感測器常受共同環境影響，不能把相關訊號誤當成多份獨立證據。 標準差估計須對應同一殘差定義，原始位移的季節變幅不能直接充當去季節後模型誤差的標準差。~A monitoring model can remove calibrated reservoir-level and seasonal effects to expose residuals for investigation. Standardization helps compare variables with different units only when the baseline period and variance estimate are valid. Nearby instruments often share environmental effects, so correlated signals must not be counted as several independent confirmations. The standard deviation must match the residual definition; seasonal variation in raw displacement cannot directly represent uncertainty after those seasonal effects have been removed.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：y=7.2 mm; yhat=5.4 mm; sigma=0.6 mm; z=(y-yhat)/sigma=3。模型邊界：正常基線的標準差固定；數值僅示範殘差，並非本壩警報或安全判準。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: y=7.2 mm; yhat=5.4 mm; sigma=0.6 mm; z=(y-yhat)/sigma=3. Model boundary: fixed standard deviation from an assumed baseline; the result illustrates a residual, not a project alarm or safety criterion.
units.verify: 同時檢查溫度、庫水位、量測基準及維修紀錄，將殘差與附近不同原理儀器比較。若僅單一通道偏離而獨立測量穩定，先查儀器；若多種原理同時偏離，再追查共同結構或水力原因。~Review temperature, reservoir level, reference control and maintenance records together, then compare residuals with nearby instruments using different physical principles. An isolated channel suggests an instrument issue; coherent changes across independent methods justify investigating a shared structural or hydraulic mechanism.
units.failure: 基線若含長期漂移，標準差會被放大而掩蓋新異常；若校準資料只涵蓋低水位，外推至高水位也會產生假殘差，不能直接宣告壩體劣化。~A drifting baseline inflates the standard deviation and can conceal new changes. A model trained only at low reservoir levels can also create false residuals at high levels, which do not alone demonstrate dam deterioration.
units.misconception: 標準化殘差可直接當通用安全評分~A standardized residual directly provides a universal safety score.
units.practice: 建立包含季節項的假想量測序列，分別加入感測器跳值與緩慢結構位移，畫出原始值和殘差，提出可區分兩種原因的獨立觀測。~Create a hypothetical seasonal series and separately insert a sensor jump and slow structural movement. Plot observations and residuals, then propose an independent measurement that can distinguish the two underlying causes.
